:::: publication-body
[Journal article]{.publication-type} [Policy Studies]{.publication-venue}

[Redesigning choice to tackle school segregation: the impact of Barcelona’s desegregation policies]{.publication-title}

[This study examines the impact of these policies on school segregation and explores how their effectiveness varies according to the characteristics of different areas within the city. The findings indicate that desegregation policies have reduced the uneven distribution of socially disadvantaged students and their isolation in specific schools.]{.publication-summary}

::: publication-links
[Download the document](https://tinyurl.com/34b8wcfp){.btn-primary-link} [Pre-print version](https://tinyurl.com/yzu9wcvb){.btn-secondary-link}

:::: publication-body
[Journal article]{.publication-type} [Journal of Education Policy]{.publication-venue}

[Unpacking policy instruments through a mechanistic analysis: school desegregation policies in Barcelona]{.publication-title}

[Drawing on a mechanistic approach to policy instruments and a realist evaluation methodology, this article examines how beneficiary families respond to the key instruments of Barcelona's school desegregation policies: access quotas and additional funding for socially disadvantaged students. The findings show that, while in some cases these instruments achieve the expected outcome, in others they are insufficient to change beneficiaries' school choice patterns.]{.publication-summary}

::: publication-links
[Download the document](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/02680939.2026.2743590){.btn-primary-link} [Pre-print version](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/415707135_Unpacking_policy_instruments_through_a_mechanistic_analysis_School_desegregation_policies_in_Barcelona){.btn-secondary-link}
:::
